reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, so the on-the-go sachet doesn't solve anything for me. I'd also forget a box on the counter like I forget my other vitamins.
objection: I don't travel with my vitamins, I take them at home. Paying $30 for the sachet format when a bottle of magnesium is cheaper feels like paying for something I don't use.
would_change_my_mind: A creator video showing a problem I actually have, like waking at 3am, plus a price closer to what my current bottle costs.
